messages:
mike: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6123 to consolidate console observability examples (dashboards, tracehook, cost/latency). looking for quick reviewers; goal is to ship end-of-week.

sophia: looks good at a glance. quick q — do we keep a single md with language tabs or separate files per lang?

mike: leaning separate snippet files per language under examples/console/observability/ and one canonical overview md that embeds them. less duplication, easier CI.

luis: I can do screenshots + update GIFs. any size/format prefs? prefer SVG for dash images, GIF for short flows.

carla: heads up — trace hook param renamed in runtime from `tracekey` -> `tracing_key`. PR needs snippet updates and a migration note. also the sample console UI path changed (`/console/v1/dashboards` -> `/console/v2/dashboards`).

mike: good catch. I'll add a migration note section and inline code diffs. sample diff:

```diff
- client.post('/v1/generate', headers={'X-TraceKey': key})
+ client.post('/v1/generate', headers={'X-Tracing-Key': key})
```

sophia: also found two stale links in the dashboard quickstart — https://old.docs/link1 and https://old.docs/link2 — will open tiny PR to redirect.

docs-bot: PR opened by sophia: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6124 (link redirects)

luis: on screenshots. I'll replace the header bar to match Console v2 and upload assets to static-hosting. ETA EOD.

carla: I'll update tracehook snippets + add a unit test that runs snippets against the snippet CI harness (so we catch regressions).

mike: awesome. action items: luis (screenshots + assets), carla (trace param + tests), sophia (link redirects + snippet smoke), mike (migration note + canonical md). please add yourself as reviewer/assignee on PR 6123.

sophia: ack :thumbsup: \n
luis: assigned and started — will post delta here when ready.

mike: plan to merge and stage on Monday, cut a minor docs release Tue if CI green. if anyone hits blockers ping me.

luis: posted screenshot diff: https://img.redwood.internal/snap-obs-6123.png

carla: tests passing locally, pushing fix commits now.

mike: thanks team — moving to follow-up thread for rollout once merged.
